init.title: Where to send reports
init.description: Both are optional: leave a field empty to not use it. The Telegram and Print receipt switches turn each one on or off.

data_description.printer_font: Only if the receipt text looks wrong; the default is DejaVu Sans if found

error.telegram_incomplete: Fill in both the Telegram bot token and the chat id, or neither.

send_homework_report.name: Send homework report
send_homework_report.description: Sends what's due on the next school day and the rest of the coming week. Returns the report's text when asked for a response.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Smartschool account.

date.name: Today
date.description: Pretend today is this date. Leave empty for today.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.description: Send to Telegram. Leave empty to follow the Telegram switch.

print.name: Print
print.description: Print the receipt. Leave empty to follow the Print receipt switch.

send_results_report.name: Send results report
send_results_report.description: Sends the results published since the last results report (at most 14 days back). Nothing is sent if there are none. Returns the report's text when asked for a response.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Smartschool account.

since.name: Since
since.description: Report results published since this date, instead of since the last report.
